seo.title: Warehouse — Kickback
seo.description: Warehouse tracks every piece from truck to install. Scan to receive, locate, and match material to the right CRM job — no paper load sheets.
seo.ogDescription: Complete visibility from order to install. Scan receiving, live locations, and CRM job matching for home-services warehouses.

hero.lede: Warehouse replaces paper load sheets and whiteboards with a live dashboard. Shipments import before the truck arrives, receiving is a scan, and every piece already knows which job it belongs to.
hero.metaHtml: Part of the Kickback Platform · Scanners included · No per-seat fee

sections.title: From truck to rack in minutes.
sections.lede: Connect your CRM once. Warehouse imports load manifests, matches pieces to open orders, and keeps every location live — so floor staff scan instead of hunting.

items.title: The truck arrives already matched.
items.body: We pull the load manifest or order confirmation from your supplier. Every PO, strap, bundle, and piece lands in the app before anyone unloads — no typing required.

items.title: Receiving is point and zap.
items.body: Open the truck's scan screen and zap each barcode. Scan a wrapped bundle once and every piece on that truck inside it receives in one step.

items.title: Every piece has a home.
items.body: Scan the rack, then the item — or move a whole order with one tap. Search by serial, PO, customer order, or bill of lading and get an answer in seconds.

sections.title: Where is it? One scan, not an hour of walking.
sections.body: Orders score against jobs already in your CRM. Clear matches link themselves. Uncertain ones stay unmatched with the best candidates — never the wrong customer. Shop supplies count by scan, with reorder points on the dashboard.

bullets.title: Zero rows typed
bullets.text: Load sheets import automatically from your suppliers. Upload by hand when you need to.

bullets.title: Bundle receive
bullets.text: One scan marks every piece in a wrapped bundle that is on that truck.

bullets.title: CRM job matching
bullets.text: Pieces link to the right job from your existing CRM data. You confirm the installer — the app never assigns work alone.

bullets.title: Scanners included
bullets.text: We ship configured guns at no device cost. Floor staff need no daily login. A lost gun locks with one click.

bullets.title: Shop supplies too
bullets.text: Screws, shims, caulk — multiple barcodes hit the same line. Reorder points flag what is low or out.

callout.body: Serial, bundle, PO, customer order, or bill of lading — one search answers where it is, on the gun, in seconds.

suite.body: Receive shipments by scan, know where every piece sits, and match material to the right CRM job — no paper load sheets, no hunting the warehouse.

pricing.builderDesc: Unlimited shipments and floor staff, scanners included, serialized receiving + locations, CRM job matching, shop-supply counts.
